answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, together with the TEE’s hardware-rooted attestation evidence. A verifier accepts only code and configuration matching that measurement, so copying keys or launching virtual machines cannot duplicate an identity; an attacker must obtain additional genuine silicon and pass attestation. Thus falcon, echo, and trellis remain distinct identities rather than cheap software clones.
